decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist of the song "It's Raining." Two distinct songs titled "It's Raining" are described in the provided sources. D1S1-D1S4 and the original_cards confirm that Irma Thomas is the artist of the soul/R&B ballad "It's Raining," which was first recorded in 1961. D3S1-D3S6 and the corresponding card identify Rain as the artist of the Korean-language song "It's Raining," released in 2004. These are two separate songs with the same title and distinct artists, so both answers are valid and should be preserved. Allen Toussaint is mentioned as a producer in D1S2 but is not the artist of the song, so C2 is rejected.
